author: evacfk
name: bumpreward
short: Currency rewards, streaks, auto reminders and a daily board for Disboard bumps.
description: Watches the bump channel for Disboard's successful /bump reply, pays the bumper a random reward from Red's bank with a daily-streak bonus, posts a public reward message, automatically reminds the Bumper role when the next bump is ready, and posts a daily top-bumpers board at LA midnight.
install_msg: Loaded bumpreward. Run `.bumpreward channel #bump-us`, then `.bumpreward enabled true`.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-member bump counts, streak and last bump date.
